nodes.summary: For a simple graph $G$ on a finite vertex set $V$ with $n = |V|$ elements, $X_G$ is the polynomial with integer coefficients in the variables $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$ given by $X_G = \sum_{\kappa} \prod_{v \in V} x_{\kappa(v)}$, where $\kappa$ ranges over the proper colourings $\kappa : V \to \{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ of $G$, that is, the maps with $\kappa(u) \ne \kappa(v)$ whenever $u$ and $v$ are adjacent.
nodes.title: Chromatic symmetric function in as many variables as vertices

nodes.summary: The incomparability graph $\operatorname{inc}(P)$ of a partially ordered set $P$ is the simple graph on $P$ in which two distinct elements $x$ and $y$ are adjacent when they are incomparable, that is, neither $x \le y$ nor $y \le x$.
nodes.title: Incomparability graph of a poset

nodes.summary: A polynomial $f$ with integer coefficients in the $n$ variables $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$ is $e$-positive when $f = \sum_{\lambda} c_\lambda e_\lambda$ for some natural numbers $c_\lambda$, where $\lambda = (\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_k)$ ranges over the partitions of $n$ and $e_\lambda = e_{\lambda_1} \cdots e_{\lambda_k}$ is the product of the elementary symmetric polynomials $e_{\lambda_i}$ in $x_0, \dots, x_{n-1}$.
nodes.title: $e$-positive polynomials

nodes.summary: A partially ordered set $P$ is $(3+1)$-free when there are no elements $a, b, c, d \in P$ with $a < b < c$ such that $d$ is incomparable to each of $a$, $b$ and $c$ (neither $d \le x$ nor $x \le d$ for $x = a, b, c$).
nodes.title: $(3+1)$-free posets

nodes.summary: For every finite $(3+1)$-free partially ordered set $P$, the chromatic symmetric function in $|P|$ variables of the incomparability graph of $P$ is $e$-positive.
nodes.title: Hikita's theorem: the Stanley–Stembridge conjecture holds

nodes.summary: The proposition that for every finite $(3+1)$-free partially ordered set $P$, the chromatic symmetric function in $|P|$ variables of the incomparability graph of $P$ is $e$-positive.
nodes.title: Statement of the Stanley–Stembridge conjecture
